> An observatory-themed CAD marble machine for a nominal 8 mm printed marble. A manual selector chooses between a funnel route and an adjustable tipping-cup route, which merge into a guarded three-tray cascade and front collector. Detachable track sections and a fit coupon support assembly and tolerance checks. Current stage: CAD design; physical operation and print fit still need testing.

## Design

### 2026-10-18 – Monday, October 12, 2026 — design planning

**5h**

Monday, October 12, 2026 — design planning

I worked on planning the marble machine and deciding what I wanted the project to do. My starting concept was a compact switchback course for an 8 mm marble, with bends and supports guiding its path downward. I focused on the overall layout and how to make the route interesting while keeping the design small enough to become a manageable 3D printing project.

Time: 5 hours, recorded retrospectively. The first image is my day-one design reference. The four additional views were rendered October 18 from the saved design geometry; they are retrospective reference views.

### 2026-10-18 – Tuesday, October 13, 2026 — initial 3D modeling

**5h**

Tuesday, October 13, 2026 — initial 3D modeling

I started 3D modeling and developed the basic structure of the marble run. I explored the observatory theme, including a version with two descending orbits and another with a cascade layout. I also worked with a view showing just the channels so I could focus on the marble’s route separately from the surrounding architecture. This gave me a clearer starting point for the next revision.

Time: 5 hours, recorded retrospectively. The first three images are my day-two design references. The two additional views were rendered October 18 from the saved design geometry; they are retrospective reference views.

### 2026-10-18 – Wednesday, October 14, 2026 — revising the design

**5h**

Wednesday, October 14, 2026 — revising the design

I realized I wasn’t happy with the earlier design and revised it to include more variety and more things happening along the marble’s path. The revised design developed into two selectable routes: a funnel and a tipping cup with an adjustable counterweight. These routes join before a shared cascade and collector. I wanted the model to have several distinct features while still feeling like one observatory-themed machine.

Time: 5 hours, recorded retrospectively. The attached images are final-model references extracted from the supplied CAD animation on October 18; they illustrate the design and are not screenshots captured during the dated session.
